description: A script for updating test error expectations based on actual test results, specifically for verifying certificate chain errors in unit tests.

methods.name: read_file_to_string
methods.description: Reads a file entirely into a string.

methods.name: write_string_to_file
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: get_src_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the source tree by locating 'src'.

methods.name: get_abs_path
methods.description: Converts a relative path (from src) to an absolute path.

methods.name: fixup_errors_for_file
methods.description: Updates the error expectations in a test file with actual errors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes test output to update error expectations.
